label: Aristotle rejected transcendent Forms in favor of immanent substance and empirical observation
description: Aristotle formulated a fundamental critique of "Theory of Forms", challenging its coherence and proposing an alternative model.
dialecticalTension: Dialectical engagement with the core claims and paradoxes of "Theory of Forms".
historicalContext: Inherited and re-evaluated during the Classical Greek.

label: Plotinus integrated Platonic Forms into the Divine Intellect (Nous)
description: Plotinus took up the concept of "Theory of Forms" and systematized its implications for later thought.
dialecticalTension: Dialectical engagement with the core claims and paradoxes of "Theory of Forms".
historicalContext: Inherited and re-evaluated during the Hellenistic & Roman.
